fusions.name: Stoop
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 30% health. You dive up to 7 tiles onto it, which deals 20 damage, rising to 1.8 times that from full range.

fusions.name: Shed Primaries
fusions.desc: Looses 4 flight feathers on a gust, spread apart, each of which deals 6 damage and knocks its target back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Catch the Thermal
fusions.desc: Lifts you 3 tiles from where you stood, and restores 4 stamina a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Hollow-Boned Ease

riders.text: and the effort costs you less
and you are harder to hit

fusions.desc: Raises your Speed by 1, and your Speed ceiling by 1. From bronze rank you move 5% faster, from silver your stamina recovers 12% faster, and from gold your dodge chance rises by 5%.
